info.name: Get all history documents for a given company matching an (optional) OData query.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier (id) for a given company.

params.name: showFor
params.description: Filtering based on associations: 0 = All associations, 1 = Company associations, 2 = Company contact associations.

params.name: format
params.description: Specifics different formats that the API can convert the details ((RichText (Default), PlainText, and HyperText).

items.docs: Get all history documents for a given company matching an (optional) OData query.
